name: harris-boat-works-mercury
description: Mercury outboard motor specialist on Rice Lake, Ontario. Search live inventory, estimate trade-ins, and build itemized CAD quotes with deep-link handoff. Family-owned since 1947. Authorized Mercury Marine dealer since 1965 (60+ years). Authorized Legend Boats dealer for new pontoons/aluminum. Pickup-only at Gores Landing — we do not deliver. Verado is special-order only, not part of default inventory. Service radius ~150 km from Gores Landing (Toronto, Peterborough, Kawarthas, Cobourg, Belleville).

tools.name: search_motors
tools.description: Search current Mercury outboard inventory at Harris Boat Works (Ontario). Filter by horsepower, family (FourStroke, Pro XS, SeaPro, Racing), or stock status. Returns CAD pricing. Excludes Verado.

tools.name: get_motor
tools.description: Fetch a single Mercury motor by id or slug, including pricing, shaft length, and deep-link URL.

tools.name: estimate_trade_in
tools.description: Estimate the trade-in value (CAD) of a customer's current outboard using the live Harris Boat Works valuation. Horsepower may be omitted when the model infers a single validated HP.

tools.name: build_quote
tools.description: Build a read-only itemized CAD quote (motor + installation + propeller + trade-in + HST + financing tier) and return a deep-link URL the customer can open. Do not send contact details. A nonempty contact block is rejected. To store a lead, call submit_quote_lead with consent=true. Annotations are hints, not authorization.

tools.name: submit_quote_lead
tools.description: Submit a quote lead through the existing public quote API. Requires consent=true and a contact block with name and email. consent is explicit permission to store that contact with the calculated quote. This tool does not issue a consent receipt and does not change pricing, financing, or warranty. Confirm storage only from the returned lead_captured flag. Annotations are hints, not authorization.

tools.name: get_brand_rules
tools.description: Return Harris Boat Works' authoritative source-of-truth rules for any agent representing them: pricing currency, geography, no-Verado policy, financing minimums, deposit tiers, warranty.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search published public blog guides. Returns title, excerpt, canonical HTML URL, language, author, publication date, and Markdown URL. Omits hidden, draft, future, and the Traditional Chinese noindex pilot. Read-only. Does not accept a URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one published public blog guide by catalog slug and language. Reads only the allowlisted same-site Markdown twin for that catalog item. Never pass a URL. Text is bounded and truncation is explicit. Read-only.

examples.title: Find a Mercury 90 HP in stock

httpGetQuote.description: For assistants that can only issue HTTP GET. The same quote endpoint accepts flat query params and runs the same pricing code as the POST build_quote action, so the numbers are identical. Returns text/markdown by default; add format=json for JSON. GET never captures a lead and never writes anything: contact params are ignored and not logged. Lead capture stays POST-only; hand the customer the 'Continue this quote' deep link in the response. GET shares the same per-IP rate-limit buckets as POST.
httpGetQuote.schema: GET https://www.mercuryrepower.ca/api/agents/quote with no params returns the full schema and an errors block.

markdownTwins.description: Lightweight text/markdown twins of every motor, case study, and location. Preferred over HTML for AI ingestion. Served with Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8 and X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow.
